items.title_en: Indian-Origin CEO Supports Bryan Johnson’s Decision To Stop ‘Anti-Ageing’ Drug: ‘Keep Going’
items.title_zh: 印度裔首席执行官支持布莱恩·约翰逊停止“抗衰老”药物的决定：“继续前进”
items.summary_en: Indian-origin CEO of Perplexity AI, Aravind Srinivas, showed his support to Bryan Johnson who faced criticism for taking rapamycin.
items.summary_zh: Perplexity AI 的印度裔首席执行官 Aravind Srinivas 对因服用雷帕霉素而受到批评的布莱恩·约翰逊表示支持。
